target.title: fix #99163: harden large chat attachment parsing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Large clipboard image data URLs currently pass through whole-string base64 validation and full-payload MIME sniffing. For multi-megabyte attachments this does unnecessary work on the hot path and can make attachment parsing much more expensive than the small header sniff actually needs.

## Summary

- replace chat attachment base64 validation regex with an iterative scanner so large clipboard payloads avoid whole-string regexp matching
- make MIME sniffing decode only a small canonical base64 prefix instead of canonicalizing the entire attachment body
- add regression coverage for ~1.9MB PNG clipboard data URLs and large base64 MIME sniffing

Fixes #99163.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/chat-attachments.test.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.test.ts --reporter=verbose` — 116 passed across gateway shards + 3 unit-fast
- `OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/gateway/chat-attachments.ts src/gateway/chat-attachments.test.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.test.ts` — passed
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.non-agents.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test-non-agents.tsbuildinfo` — passed
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/gateway/chat-attachments.ts src/gateway/chat-attachments.test.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.test.ts` — passed
- `git diff --check` — passed

Note: the branch was rebased onto latest upstream `main` after CI exposed an unrelated `session-accessor.reply-init-concurrency` JSON race that was fixed by upstream #99212.
